posts.author: amit.wilson
posts.text: The IPO has closed successfully and the numbers look like this: EAAA valued at Rs 10,765 cr with a share price of Rs 1,665/- Edelweiss to receive Rs 1,200 cr and will retain 78.4% of EAAA valued at Rs 8,400 cr. Current market cap of Edelweiss is Rs 11,965 cr.

posts.author: amit.wilson
posts.text: The explicit value unlock will be the cash received by the parent company in this OFS of the subsidiary. That will most likely be used to reduce their debt. ₹1,100–1,200 cr of deleveraging should transfer that value to the equity of the company. This IPO puts the value of EAAA at ~₹11,000 cr at the top end. With the parent retaining 84% of the stock, that is about ~₹9,000 cr of listed stock on the balance sheet of Edelweiss. This is againt the current market cap of ~₹12,000 cr. As with other holding companies, the market will apply some discount to the ~₹9,000 cr of EAAA held by Edelweiss. Eve…
